items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And Lucci Roman was playing tramo.

ctx.x: Did the other guys do that much?

No, just him. Just him. He was the only one. But his band was a big difference. He was just a lot of drummers. Well, I feel all together different. Like, I forgot this piano we were playing. We were calling. I don't see it all. Little Thomas was playing drums. That's it. Little Thomas was calling. And Lucci Roman was playing tramo.
Lucci? Lucci. Yeah, I know him.
